title: Thread-setup test uses try_recv() where a bounded recv_timeout is needed; Superseded branch untested
outcome:
From round-4 review of the Codex thread-setup work.

(1) Codex M2 — prompt_during_codex_thread_setup_does_not_start_a_second_thread calls input_rx.try_recv() immediately after the first asynchronous handoff to assert no SECOND StartTurnAfterSetup arrives. A second handoff could land just afterwards and the assertion would still pass (false positive). Use a bounded recv_timeout, or synchronise on the waiter, before asserting absence.

(2) Claude M2 — CodexThreadSetupCompletion::Superseded has no direct test. It is now only reachable via detach/reset (a prompt never supersedes an in-flight setup), and it disowns the thread by suppressing it. Worth pinning: detach mid-setup -> the waiter's response lands -> thread is suppressed, no turn is started, no stale binding is left.
